name: recurrent-sac-package-2026-10-27
hypothesis: A bounded observation-history GRU with off-policy replay may improve selected AND final cost-aware development returns versus fresh native SAC and the established masked RecurrentPPO reference. This is a package comparison, not isolated memory attribution.
selection: Strict equal-weight mean net return over exact26 validation symbol episodes; earliest ties; only post-optimizer checkpoint states; selected and final separate. No test selection.

interpretation.observations: Native SAC and GRU-SAC share full21 input. Strong RecurrentPPO reference masks nine held-execution coordinates, retaining21 dimensions. No claim of identical information across all three.
interpretation.capacity: GRU-SAC has independent observation-only actor/twin/target GRU64. Native SAC is64x64 MLP; reference has separate actor/critic LSTM64. Different capacities, replay batches and on/off-policy update counts are declared package differences.
interpretation.budget: 100000 means collected transitions per arm, not compute units. Three seed11 cells total300000 transitions; confirmation adds only seeds23/37, never repeats seed11.100k preserves the established panel-coverage budget rather than extending a deteriorating model.
interpretation.old_results: Prior original26-training SAC returns are not matched111-panel controls. Old guard selected28.07/final24.44 and masked reference19.62/18.48 are descriptive historical context, not new checkpoint selectors or an integrity-stop override.

screen_gate.failure: Close this fixed GRU-SAC package after failed complete seed11 performance gates; no extra steps, reward/indicator/architecture/sequence/learning-rate grids or confirmation to rescue it. Operational/profile failures retain evidence and do not become performance findings.

confirmation_gate.interpretation: Development gates only; a frozen prospective comparison remains required

confirmation: Only after all complete seed11 gates pass, run both remaining seeds23/37 for all three roles. Require two of three seeds to pass the same paired/absolute gates, mean paired gains>=2pp selected AND final versus both controls, mean drawdown worsening<=2pp, and at least two positive paired final seeds. No new search if confirmation fails. Mean cells average seed scores, group returns/drawdowns and each seed stock-median excess. Outperformance additionally requires nonnegative selected/final stock AND ETF mean excess and the same nonnegative group condition in at least two individual seeds.
short_side: Same-symbol marked long/short P&L and costs required; future-defined decliners reporting only, never input/sampling/checkpoint selection. Positive total return AND net short P&L required before describing a declining-stock episode as profitable shorting.
initialization: New portable unfitted seed11/23/37 assets per architecture, full Torch/NumPy/Python streams, exact initial tensor/RNG/empty-optimizer acceptance before any gradient. Different architectures cannot share all weights; no fitted-weight transfer. Generate once, no data or performance selection.

profiling.measurement: Colab CPU only: separate collection, sampled replay/update, full512-observation actor refresh, native control work, full26 validation, checkpoint/report/archive I/O. Retain models/counts/source; profile scores cannot admit a family.
profiling.percentile: Empirical95th percentile, higher order statistic; warm recurrent update timings discard first8 of64 updates; all measured samples finite positive; no local backward to profile. Native SAC retains all64 update timings; PPO retains all three1000-transition rollout timings (p95 is their maximum).
profiling.admission: Every projected arm plus600 setup and360 teardown must fit7200; aggregate current rate/account/project guards must pass. Failure blocks performance task construction; never reduce100k or change model settings to pass profiling.

execution.training_location: Google Colab only, actual default kernel checked
execution.concurrency: Configurable after aggregate admission; no project-wide cap of two or CPU-only authorization is implied
execution.persistence: One shared original-ledger study baseline across profile/screen/confirmation; immutable claims for each role/seed/phase; retain delayed debits and prior stops; no automatic cell retry, resume or restart after failure/budget stop.
execution.metering: Aggregate account readings every minute, integrate between readings; include setup/idle/downloads/failures; bounded durable retrieval before verified owned teardown. Stop only task-owned sessions if metering is unreliable.

limitations: Repeated2021-2023 development, survivor panel, revised free history and correlated symbols remain. Neither a screen nor multi-seed development success proves prospective outperformance. Retired2024+ interval remains closed; frozen independent prospective evidence and portable bundle acceptance before promotion.
